item.title: Distilling Formal Logic into Neural Spaces
item.description: Continuous neural representations of STL specifications via kernel distillation. Accepted at NeSy 2026.

item.title: STLDec: Decoding Temporal Logic Embeddings via Transformers
item.description: Transformer-based decoder for inverting semantic embeddings of Signal Temporal Logic (STL) formulae. Published at ECML-PKDD 2025.

item.title: OverRef: Studying Over-Refusal in Large Language Models
item.description: Ongoing project on over-refusal in LLMs: studying when and why models refuse legitimate user queries, with benchmarking and dataset resources.
